findings.resolution: tools/lint/pure-config.mjs: PURE_SOURCE_EXTENSIONS = [ts,tsx,mts,cts]; PURE_PACKAGE_GLOBS and IMPURE_PACKAGE_GLOBS derived from that list. Added tests/fixtures/lint/forbidden/{math-random-mts.mts,node-import-cts.cts}. tests/lint/rules.test.mjs adds two production-config tests that use the real /workspace/eslint.config.mjs to prove packages/**/*.mts and packages/**/*.cts are rejected end-to-end; tests/config/workspace.test.mjs asserts all four extensions are present in both glob lists.

tools/boundary/lib.mjs: validateImports now uses allowedDirect (declared DIRECT_EDGES) instead of allowedTransitive. tools/boundary/check.mjs passes allowedDirect. tests/boundary/graph.test.mjs replaced the transitive-allowed assertion with `rejects apps -> core as an undeclared direct edge (no transitive reach)` and added a CLI transitive-violation test using an adapters -> world attempt routed through application.

tools/boundary/lib.mjs now resolves relative import specifiers against the source file's directory, matches the longest workspace package root, and rejects any cross-package relative edge that is not declared in DIRECT_EDGES. check.mjs threads sourceFile and packageCategoryByDir into validateImports. Added an end-to-end CLI test that materialises a temp workspace where core/src/index.ts imports ../../domain/src/index.ts and asserts the boundary CLI exits 1 with `Forbidden edge core -> domain`.

Made pnpm available in the sandbox (`corepack enable pnpm --install-directory /tmp/pnpm-bin`, PATH updated) and executed every required root command against the corrected candidate: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` (Already up to date, 16 workspace projects), `pnpm run compile`, `pnpm run lint`, `pnpm run boundary` (15 packages OK), and `pnpm run test` (33/33 passing). CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml) runs the same five steps.

notes_for_reviewer: Boundary validation is now edge-strict: allowedDirect from DIRECT_EDGES is the only permission source; transitive reach is exercised only by negative tests (adapters cannot cross world through application).

Relative import resolution matches the longest containing workspace package by directory prefix and consults RESOLUTION_EXTENSIONS (.ts, .tsx, .mts, .cts) plus index.* fallbacks, so specifiers such as `../../domain/src/index.ts` are attributed to the domain package regardless of whether the file exists on disk.
Production-config lint tests use ESLint.lintText with a virtual filePath under packages/core/src/ so no permanent .mts/.cts source is added to the pure packages.
pnpm was installed via corepack into /tmp/pnpm-bin for local validation; CI provisions pnpm 9.15.0 via pnpm/action-setup@v4 in the existing workflow.
SPEC_BLOCKERS.md was left unchanged (already PASS in the review); no production algorithm or DEFINIR-dependent behavior was introduced; /constitution/ was not modified.

Added production-config .mts/.cts lint tests, an apps->core direct-edge rejection test, a transitive-violation test, and a relative-import fixture test.
